question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

RECEIVE
solution:
The correct answer is "**Give**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given word in question.
 
• **Receive**: be given, presented with, or paid (something).
 
 
• **Example**: *He **received **__a generous amount as a cash prize.*
 
 
 
• The meaning of the given options.
 
• **Obtain**: get, acquire, or secure (something).
 
• **Give: **freely transfer the possession of (something) to (someone).
 
• **Follow: **go or come after (a person or thing proceeding ahead); move or travel behind.
 
• **Abandon: **cease to support or look after (someone); desert.
 
• The meaning of **receive **is completely opposite to **give.**
 __
 
• **Example:*** He wanted to **give __**me a gift for my birthday.*
 
 

**Hence, the correct answer is option 2**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__** 

 
• **Receive**: प्राप्त
 
• आइए शब्दों के अर्थ को देखें
 
• **Give**: देना
 
• **Obtain**: प्राप्त करना
 
• **Follow**: अनुसरण
 
• **Abandon**: त्याग देना
 
• **प्राप्त **का अर्थ **देने **के बिल्कुल विपरीत है।
